# lumos_custom_attribute_definitions (Data Source)

CustomAttributeDefinitions DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_custom_attribute_definitions" "my_customattributedefinitions" {
  app_id         = "87b49206-e897-4b47-b1e1-7766eb3ad241"
  attribute_type = "GROUP"
  config_type    = "FOUND_ACCOUNT"
  label          = "...my_label..."
  page_size      = 100
  page_token     = "...my_page_token..."
  source_type    = "NATIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) UUID of an app. Returns only the definitions that app supplies.
- `attribute_type` (String) Filter by the type of value the attribute holds. must be one of ["STRING", "BOOLEAN", "INTEGER", "DATETIME", "JSON", "USER", "GROUP", "MULTISELECT", "SINGLESELECT"]
- `config_type` (String) Filter by the entity type the attribute attaches to (USER or ACCOUNT). must be one of ["USER", "FOUND_ACCOUNT", "VENDOR_AGREEMENT", "DOMAIN_APP", "ACCOUNT", "ENTITLEMENT", "REPORTED_TRANSACTION", "ORDER", "UNREVIEWED_ORDER", "ONBOARDING_RULE", "ACCESS_POLICY"]
- `label` (String) Return the single unified definition for this exact label.
- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 1000 are clamped to 1000 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `source_type` (String) Filter by where the attribute comes from: `SYNCED` from a connected app, `NATIVE` defined by your team in Lumos, or `AI_GENERATED` inferred by Lumos. must be one of ["SYNCED", "NATIVE", "AI_GENERATED"]

### Read-Only

- `custom_attribute_definitions` (Attributes List) Custom attribute definitions returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_attribute_definitions))
- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_attribute_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_attribute_definitions`

Read-Only:

- `attribute_type` (String) Value type: STRING/USER/GROUP/SINGLESELECT/MULTISELECT/…
- `config_type` (String) Entity type this attribute attaches to: USER or ACCOUNT.
- `label` (String) Stable public reference (unique per domain after unification).
- `name` (String) Representative machine/synced attribute name.
- `source_type` (String) SYNCED / NATIVE / AI_GENERATED.
